title: The SpaceX IPO Is Days Away: Could the Stock Join the S&P 500, and How Soon?
title_zh: 距离 SpaceX 首次公开募股还有几天：该股能否加入标准普尔 500 指数？需要多快？
summary: Index fund buying could one day become a powerful force behind the rocket maker's stock. But some of the index's oldest rules stand in the way.
summary_zh: 指数基金购买有一天可能会成为火箭制造商股票背后的强大力量。但该指数的一些最古老的规则却阻碍了这一进程。

title: Dow Jones Futures Rise, Oil Pops, Oracle Dives; SpaceX IPO On Launch Pad
title_zh: 道琼斯期货上涨，石油流行，甲骨文下跌； SpaceX 首次公开募股在发射台上
summary: Futures were little changed while oil prices rose as Trump launched new U.S. attacks vs. Iran. Oracle tumbled on earnings. The SpaceX IPO is on tap.
summary_zh: 随着特朗普对伊朗发起新的美国攻击，期货几乎没有变化，而油价上涨。甲骨文的盈利大幅下滑。 SpaceX 的 IPO 即将进行。

title: IPOs- How Much is TOO Much
title_zh: 首次公开募股——多少才算太多
summary: When I was a kid, I begged my parents to go to Golden Corral. It’s a Southern staple. Not because it has good food, but because it has ALL the food.

title: Market Minute 6-09-26- OpenAI Joins Heated IPO Race

title: Anticipated SpaceX IPO ETFs: Massive Hype or Real Opportunity?
